1.content:
Study Information and Statement of Informed Consent

Thank you for your interest in participating in our study on decision making. Please read the following text carefully. By checking the box at the bottom of this page and proceeding further you indicate that you have read the information below and that you consent to participate in the study


1. Aim of the study

In this study, we want to investigate how people make decisions between different options after learning about these options.


2. Procedure and content of the study

You will have to choose between several options. First, you will make some practice choices. Then you will complete 10 blocks of 24 choices each, for a total of 240 choices. If you need to, you will be able to take short breaks between blocks.


3. Are there any risks involved?

There are no risks involved in participation.


4. What will happen to the information and data collected?

This study is a joint research project of the University of Balearic Islands, the University of Zurich, and the Technical University of Munich (responsible researcher: carlos.rey@uib.es). The data collected will be used for research purposes only.

5. Participation is voluntary

Participation in this study is voluntary. You may withdraw from the study at any time without giving any reason and without any negative consequences. If you withdraw from the study before completing it, you will not receive the compensation or bonus payment.


6. Data

This experiment is a research project. Collected data will be analyzed for research purposes only. Experiment data may be shared for collaborative analysis. In addition, they can be publicly accessible if the article is published in a scientific journal. This allows the results to be reproduced by other researchers and promotes the quality of scientific practice. The data can also be used for new research questions that go beyond the goals of today's study. In any case, the experiment data is only transferred or published without personal contact data.


7. Consent

This document has informed you about participation in the study on decision making. The study involves an experiment of approximately 20-25 minutes. If you complete the study, you will receive a compensation that could range from 3 GBP to 7 GBP. If you do not consent by clicking the box below, you will not be able to participate in the study and you will not receive compensation. In this case, please return your submission by closing the respective tab of your browser.

15.content:
This study tests how you choose between boxes that have pixels (little dots) that differ in value, depending on their color. Pixels can be ${ state.gain_color }, ${ state.loss_color }, or ${ state.neutral_color } where ${ state.gain_color } represents gains, ${ state.loss_color } represents losses, and ${ state.neutral_color } represents neutral:

${ state.upper_gain_color } pixels represent gains.
${ state.upper_loss_color } pixels represent losses.
${ state.upper_neutral_color } pixels represent null or zeros.

You will see two boxes (like the box above) on the screen. Press the F-key to pick the left box, or J-key to pick the right box. One pixel from your chosen box will be randomly selected to determine your payoff.


In this task, you start with an initial amount of 5 GBP. Importantly, depending on your choices, this amount will increase or decrease. You can gain or lose real money.


First, you will do some practice choices that do not affect your money and where you will get feedback about your choice. Then, you will do 10 blocks of real choices that do affect your money. After each block, we will randomly pick one of your choices from that block and add or subtract the payoff of that choice from your money.

Please respond quickly and carefully.
